{"id":2055841945,"question_id":4341,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 weeks, 5 days","timestamp":1783176456,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"8 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2055841945/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Valid Pair Sum","memory":"224.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    int maxValidPairSum(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int> pref(n), suff(n);\n\n        pref[0] = nums[0];\n        for(int i = 1 ; i < n ; i++) pref[i] = max(pref[i-1], nums[i]);\n\n        suff[n-1] = nums[n-1];\n        for(int i = n-2 ; i >= 0 ; i--) suff[i] = max(suff[i+1], nums[i]);\n\n        int ans = INT_MIN;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i < n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(i-k >= 0)\n            {\n                ans = max(ans, nums[i] + pref[i-k]);\n            }\n\n            if(i+k < n)\n            {\n                ans = max(ans, nums[i] + suff[i+k]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        return ans == INT_MIN ? -1 : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-valid-pair-sum","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2295}
